roles.parentOnly: Parent area reserved for parent accounts.

welcome.subtitle: Ամենօրյա առաջադրանքներ ընտանիքի համար։ Ծնողներ՝ հաշիվ + կոդ։ Երեխաներ՝ միացեք կոդով իրենց սարքից (միայն չեքլիստ).
welcome.cardText:
• Ծնող — ստեղծեք հաշիվ, կառավարեք առաջադրանքներն ու ընտանեկան կոդը։
• Երեխա — մուտքագրեք կոդը երեխայի iPhone-ում (պահանջվում է ցանց)։ Այդ սարքում ծնողի տարածք չկա։
welcome.footer: Դեմոն 100% տեղական է (առանց հաշվի) — իդեալական է վեբում UI փորձարկելու համար։
welcome.parentHint: Sign in to manage tasks, the calendar, and the family code.
welcome.childHint: Enter the code a parent gave you on this device.

signUp.title: Ստեղծել ծնողի հաշիվ
signUp.hint: Cloud parent account (Supabase). A 6-character family code will be generated so the child can join from their own iPhone.
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.body: Email reset is not available in local prototype mode. On this device, create a parent account again or use “Continue in demo”.
forgot.note: Supabase Auth email reset to wire later — and Sign in with Apple on iOS before App Store.

redeem.title: Join a family
redeem.hint: Enter the 6-character code shown on the parent's phone (Internet required). The child will then pick a profile. This device only gets the child checklist — not the parent dashboard or task creation.

familyShare.title: Family sharing
familyShare.blockedBody: Family sharing (invite codes) is reserved for the parent account.
familyShare.demoBody: Available after creating a parent account. In demo mode, use seed profiles on the same device (no cloud sync).
familyShare.body: Show this code to your child. On their iPhone they open Famlist → “Join a family” and enter the code (Internet required). Lists sync via Supabase.

profiles.noKidsChild: No child profile yet. Ask a parent to create one.
profiles.noKidsParent: No children — add some from the parent dashboard.
profiles.demoBanner: Demo mode — seed data. Pick a profile.
profiles.hintChildDevice: Child device · family “{{name}}” — pick your profile (checklist only).
profiles.hintDefault: Pick a profile to get started.
profiles.resetBody: Local data will be replaced by the demo set (parent + seed children).

childHome.addToCalendar: Add my tasks to the calendar

childHistory.title: Պատմություն
childHistory.subtitle: {{name}} · completion calendar
childHistory.hint: Tap a day to see completed tasks and photos.
childHistory.noCompletionsYet: No completed tasks this month yet.

calendar.hint: Tap a day to see detail by child and tasks.

taskDetail.webNote: Browser demo: the photo button opens an image file picker. If the picker errors, a mock photo may be used. Local notifications are disabled on the web.

taskForm.noChildren: No child profile — create one first.
taskForm.deleteBody: Task “{{title}}” and its completions will be removed.

childForm.name: First name *
childForm.addedBody: {{name}} appears in the picker and filters.
childForm.deleteBody: “{{name}}” and their tasks / completions will be removed. This cannot be undone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.webUnavailable: Local reminders do not work on the web. Try Expo Go on a real device.
notifications.webUnavailableParent: Unavailable on the web. On device: Expo Go + notification permission.

deviceCalendar.title: Օրացույց
deviceCalendar.webUnavailable: Calendar is not available on the web. Use Expo Go on a phone.
deviceCalendar.added: {{count}} task(s) added to the calendar for today.
deviceCalendar.webDownloaded: {{count}} task(s) ready. Open the .ics file to add them to your calendar.

webBanner.text: Web demo mode: UI + local data OK. Notifications off. Photo = file picker (feedback shown).

language.title: Լեզու
language.subtitle: Ընտրեք միջերեսի լեզուն։ Առաջին գործարկման ժամանակ հայտնաբերվում է ավտոմատ․ այստեղ կարող եք փոխել։
